notes: I changed R2/R3: capitalization of the first letter only happens when the first character of the (m-removed) string is itself alphabetic. If the string starts with a space, digit, or symbol, all letters are lowercased. This explains E7's `"  apple..."`, `" Example"`, and `" functionend."` (all left lowercase), and is consistent with E1's `" Zebralower"` and E2's `"123 hello"`/`" hello"`.
